crossCheck.interpretation: The difference is consistent with network round-trip plus worker/API orchestration overhead, but is not a direct network latency measurement.

cudaIterationTiming.note: P95 is an interpolated sample percentile over only 10 measured iterations and should not be treated as a robust tail-latency characterization.

workerBenchmarkProcess.scope: Worker-side benchmark subprocess wall-clock duration; includes Python startup, PyTorch import, CUDA/runtime initialization, allocation, warmup, measured iterations, result serialization, and process teardown.
